name: YouTube Videos
description: Pulls the videos of a YouTube channel (links, thumbnails, titles) and ships a Verso carousel block with title filtering and a video-count limit. Works keyless out of the box via the channel RSS feed (latest 15); add a YouTube Data API v3 key for the full upload history.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read the configured channel and the cached video list.
Store the configured channel and cache the fetched video list.
Read the YouTube Data API key from the plugin's own settings table (options are readable by other plugins, so the key lives in a wjp_ table instead).
Create/update the plugin's own settings table holding the API key.
Fetch the channel's video list from youtube.com (RSS) or googleapis.com (Data API v3).
Expose the admin settings endpoints and the public video list the block consumes.
Add the YouTube Videos entry to the admin sidebar.
